description:
You are an MLOps engineer reviewing logged experiment artifact types. In /home/user/mlops/experiments/artifacts.txt you will find a file containing one artifact type per line, such as "model", "log", or "plot". Some types appear multiple times. Your task is to generate a frequency count report of each unique artifact type (case-sensitive), sorted by artifact name in ascending (alphabetical) order. Output should be written to /home/user/mlops/experiments/artifact_type_counts.txt with the following format for each line (one per artifact type): 
artifact_type frequency
For example: 
log 2
model 5
plot 3
Each line must use a single space as a separator, and there should be no leading/trailing whitespace. The output file should contain only the frequency count report with no other text. Overwrite any existing artifact_type_counts.txt file.
